description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable class 'ImmutableMeasurement' which models a measurement with metrics, success status, timestamp, and JSON serialization/deserialization logic within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package.

classes.name: ImmutableMeasurement
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the Measurement interface, representing a measurement with type, success status, timestamp, and count data, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the metric type of the measurement.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Indicates whether the measurement was successful.

methods.name: getCounts
methods.description: Returns the map of durations to count values.

methods.name: getLastMessageAt
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of the last message.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the measurement to a JSON object based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableMeasurement instance from a JSON object.
